garden.title: A place to pause
garden.text: One dry morning, Tortoise reached a quiet garden. Water whispered beyond the reeds, and a broad tree offered shade. Tortoise had promised to bring the village a lesson in patience. Where should Tortoise begin?
garden.sslGloss: TORTOISE GARDEN ARRIVE. WATER NEAR. TREE SHADE. CHOOSE.

pond.title: By the water
pond.text: Tortoise sat beside the pond. A small bird rushed past three times before noticing the water. Tortoise waited, listened, and showed the bird a safe place to drink. They returned to the village together. The lesson: patience can make room for kindness. Your story is complete.
pond.sslGloss: TORTOISE POND SIT. BIRD WATER FIND. WAIT. HELP. KINDNESS. STORY FINISH.

tree.title: Under the tree
tree.text: Tortoise rested beneath the tree. Soon a tired hare arrived. Tortoise moved a little, making space in the shade. The hare stayed to listen instead of racing away. They returned to the village together. The lesson: a small kindness can help everyone slow down. Your story is complete.
tree.sslGloss: TREE SHADE REST. TORTOISE SHARE. HARE REST. KINDNESS. STORY FINISH.
